#| label: setup

library(AOData)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
library(lme4)
library(nlme)


# Color scale
colscale <-  c("#009E73", "#D55E00", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", 
                "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#000000")

## Omega-3 supplementation and fatty acid profiles

Fatty acids, including including EPA (C205n3) and DHA (226n3) where measured in whole blood. We will assess the effect of supplementation on group level fatty acid profiles using mixed effects models. As preliminary models indicated heteroscedasticity of residuals, log-transformed data was used in modelling.



```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-cap: "Changes in whole-blood fatty acid profiles from baseline (T1) to post-supplementation (T2), and post-supplementation + exercise (T4), including EPA (C205n3) and DHA (226n3). Error bars represent 99% CI around estimated marginal means. Significant differences between treatment groups are indicated with * (FDR < 0.05)."
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false




idkeys <- AOData::idkeys |>
  select(participant, treat, sex, completed) |>
  filter(completed != "t1") |>
  select(-completed) 

d <- AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") 

## Set up loop to model fatty acids 

target <- d |> 
  distinct(fa) |> 
  pull(fa)



coefs <- list()
preds <- list()

for(i in seq_along(target)) {
  
  dsub <- d |> 
  filter(fa == target[i]) |> 
    mutate(lnvalue = log(value))
  
  
  # Fit model log-transformed data
  m <- lmerTest::lmer(lnvalue ~ time + time:treat + (1|participant), 
                      data = dsub)
  
  out <- bind_rows(
    broom.mixed::tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE), 
    marginaleffects::avg_comparisons(m, variables = "treat", by = "time", 
                                   transform = function(x) 100  * (exp(x) - 1)) |> 
    data.frame() |> 
    mutate(effect = "comp", 
           group = NA, 
           std.error = NA, 
           statistic = NA, 
           df = NA, 
           term = paste0(contrast,":", time)) |> 
    select(effect, 
           group,
          term,
           estimate,
           std.error, 
           statistic, 
           df, 
           conf.low, 
           conf.high) 
    ) |> 
    mutate(fa = target[i]) |> 
    select(fa, effect:conf.high)
  
  

  
  
  coefs[[i]] <- out
  preds[[i]] <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m, variables = c("time", "treat"), 
                                   transform = "exp", 
                                   conf_level = 0.99) |> 
    mutate(fa = target[i]) |> 
    data.frame()
  
}


res <- bind_rows(coefs)

preds <- bind_rows(preds) |> 
  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3")))




stats  <- res |> 
  filter(term %in% c("timeT2:treatomega", "timeT4:treatomega")) |> 
  select(fa, term, p.value) |> 
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p.value), 
         sign = if_else(fdr < 0.05, "*", ""), 
        term = gsub("time", "", term), 
        term = gsub(":treatomega", "", term)) |> 
  select(fa, time = term, p.value, sign) |> 
  inner_join(preds |> 
  summarise(.by = c(time, fa), 
  m = max(estimate))) |> 
  inner_join(d |> 
  summarise(.by = c(fa), 
          m.obs = quantile(value, 0.95))) |> 
  mutate(sign.place = m + ((m.obs - m) / 2))




AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  
  
  ggplot(aes(time, value, color = treat, group = paste(participant, fa))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
  
  ## Add model predictions

  geom_errorbar(data = preds, 
                aes(time, estimate, 
                    ymin = conf.low, 
                    ymax = conf.high, 
                    group = treat,
                    color = NULL), 
                width = 0.1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  
  geom_line(data = preds, 
            aes(time, estimate, group = treat, color = NULL), 
            alpha = 1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
    geom_point(data = preds, 
             aes(time, estimate, fill = treat, group = NULL),
             color = "black",
             size = 3,
             alpha = 1,
             shape = 21, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  # Plot statistical significance 
  geom_text(data = stats, 
            aes(time, sign.place, label = sign, 
                color = NULL, group = NULL),
        size = 6,
        show.legend = FALSE) + 

  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) +
  
   facet_wrap(~ fa, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(y = "Fatty acid concentration (&mu;g ml<sup>-1</sup>)", 
       x = "Time point", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"),   
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 12), 
        legend.position = "inside", 
        legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.1)) 

  
```
